info.name: Coffeehouse - Candidate Profiles API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman test collection for the Coffeehouse Candidate Profiles API built from the OpenAPI specification.
Includes complete CRUD coverage, query-string filtering (?ocdId), negative/failure scenarios (400, 404, 409), Location header validation, over-posting protection verification, and automated cleanup.
